title: Binance Will Add Fabric Protocol (ROBO) on Earn, Buy Crypto, Convert, VIP Loan & Margin
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to announce that  Fabric Protocol (ROBO)  will be added to  Binance Simple Earn ,  "Buy Crypto" ,  Binance Convert ,  Binance Margin , and  VIP Loan  at the respective dates and timings listed below. Earn ROBO Flexible Products  will be listed on Binance Simple Earn at  2026-03-04 16:30 (UTC)  and will be  available for subscription . Buy & Sell Crypto Users can buy  ROBO  with  VISA, MasterCard, Google Pay, Apple Pay  or buy and sell  ROBO  with their  account balances  on the “ Buy Crypto ” page, available within one hour of  ROBO  being  listed on Binance Spot .  Convert Users will be able to start trading  ROBO  against BTC, USDT, and any other tokens on  Binance Convert  at  zero fees  within one hour of  ROBO  being  listed on Binance Spot .  VIP Loan ROBO  will be listed as a borrowable coin on  VIP Loan  within one hour of  ROBO  being  listed on Binance Spot .  Margin Cross Margin & Isolated Margin Binance Margin will add  ROBO  as a new borrowable asset on Cross and Isolated Margin, as well as the  ROBO/USDT  and  ROBO/USDC  pairs on Cross and Isolated Margin at  2026-03-04 16:30 (UTC). Portfolio Margin Binance Margin will add  ROBO  as a new borrowable asset on Portfolio Margin, as well as the  ROBO/USDT  and  ROBO/USDC  pairs on Portfolio Margin at  2026-03-04 16:30 (UTC). Notes:  Please note that newly listed tokens tend to be volatile; users are encouraged to adopt stringent risk management strategies when trading such tokens. Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits, collateral ratio and rates. Guides & Related Materials: How to Buy Crypto with Credit/Debit Card How to Use Binance Convert How to Use Short on Margin Trading How to Use Long on Margin Trading Note : There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-03-04 USDC is an e-money token issued by Circle Internet Financial Europe SAS (https://www.circle.com/). USDC’s whitepaper is available  here . You may contact Circle using the following contact information: +33(1)59000130 and EEA-Customer-Support@circle.com.  Holders of USDC have a legal claim against Circle SAS as the EU issuer of USDC. These holders are entitled to request redemption of their USDC from Circle SAS. Such redemption will be made at any time and at par value.
